summary: Emulator-only source/mode preparation compiled into a relocatable RAM experiment object. Queue-4 callers, dispatch/output services and shared layouts remain retained boundaries.

rows.shim: Source and mode A32 entry exports and two-word publication veneers
rows.other_side: Queue-4 loop, retained router and machine-1 action callers
rows.removal: all entry callers link the typed owned preparation API directly

evidence.requirement: The relocatable object is linked at the experiment's allocated runtime base; installation and conditional caller receipts bind that package.

rows.shim: Retained machine dispatch, output route, display preset and memory ABI
rows.other_side: Stock dispatcher0x011e8bf8, route0x0064982c, preset0x006d1294 and memory0x0089d908
rows.removal: the packaged composition links the owned dispatch, output, preset and memory providers

evidence.requirement: The experiment binds these services to the retained addresses in the preparation contract.

rows.shim: Queue-4 payload lifetime and shared playback globals
rows.other_side: Retained message storage and machine0/1/11 consumers
rows.removal: the message producer and all shared-state consumers use the owned typed lifetime and layout contract

evidence.requirement: Queue4 serializes entry. Source-bound payload extents stay readable and disjoint from copied destinations; the experiment remains resident over the guarded PLAY interval.
